The best PS Plus games with crossplay

Your friends don't all need a PlayStation. These PS Plus games let you play with people on Xbox, PC or both, so you can join the same match or squad wherever they play. These are our ten favourites, and each one says which platforms it connects with. The full list of crossplay games follows.

What counts as crossplay

Crossplay means playing online with people on other platforms in the same game, rather than only with other PlayStation players. This list counts games in PS Plus that support crossplay with Xbox, PC or both, based on Wikipedia's list of cross-platform games, checked against the catalogue.

You'll need PS Plus to play online on PlayStation, and your friends need the game on their own platform. Some games ask you to link an account, such as an EA or Epic account, to play across platforms.

1

Helldivers 2

Co-op shooter, crossplay with Xbox and PC · PS5 · Metascore 82 · about 33 h main story

You and up to three friends drop onto alien planets to spread “managed democracy” for Super Earth, with friendly fire always on. It's chaotic and very funny, and best with a full squad.

Co-op party game, crossplay with Xbox and PC · PS4 / PS5 · Metascore 84 · about 12 h main story

Up to four chefs try to run a kitchen that keeps falling apart, shouting orders at each other. This edition has both games and all their extras, and works online across platforms as well as on the couch.

Tetris set to gorgeous music and visuals that swell as you play, plus a mode where three players team up against a boss. It's the best version of Tetris there is.

Questions

Which PS Plus games have crossplay?

The ones on this page. Helldivers 2, Overcooked! All You Can Eat, Tetris Effect: Connected and Mortal Kombat 1 are the highest rated.

Do my friends need PS Plus to crossplay?

Only PlayStation players need PS Plus. Friends on Xbox or PC need whatever their platform requires for online play.

Can I crossplay with someone on PS4 if I'm on PS5?

In most games, yes. Some, like Helldivers 2 and Mortal Kombat 1, are PS5 only.

What are the best crossplay games to play with friends?

Helldivers 2 and Overcooked! All You Can Eat. Our online co-op list has more games to play together.

Can I turn crossplay off?

Most games have a setting to play only with PlayStation players, usually in the online or network menu.
